Ruth (new-hire): hi everyone  day 2. on a company M2 laptop docked to a thunderbolt hub at my desk. ssh to bastion frequently freezes after ~5-10 minutes and git over HTTPS sometimes returns 'Could not resolve host'. using WireGuard split-tunnel profile from onboarding. any ideas?

Ben (infra): welcome! odd combo (dock + WG) can cause network interface flaps which break long TCP sessions. two quick checks: 1) do you have a ~/.ssh/config entry for the bastion? 2) what's your WireGuard AllowedIPs and DNS? no secrets, just the subnets.

Ruth (new-hire): here's the host stanza:

```
Host bastion.prod
  HostName bastion.us-east-1.redwood
  User ruth
  ProxyCommand ssh -W %h:%p jump.redwood
```

Katarina (it-support): thanks. couple things to try: switch ProxyCommand -> ProxyJump, add ServerAliveInterval 30 + ServerAliveCountMax 3. Also on macs with docks the primary interface can change when the thunderbolt hub sleeps/wakes. Force WireGuard to provide the internal DNS (eg 10.0.4.2) so resolution doesn't switch to your ISP resolver.

Ben (infra): also run `ifconfig` or `networksetup -listallhardwareports` to see if an interface reappears/disappears when it happens. If the dock is causing short flaps, keepalive helps but the better fix is to pin DNS or add /etc/resolver/redwood -> nameserver 10.0.4.2 as a short-term workaround.

Ruth (new-hire): did `ssh -vvv` while it froze. snippet:

```
debug1: channel 0: rcvd eof
Read from socket failed: Connection reset by peer
```

maintenance-bot: scheduled rolling reboot: bastion-3 will reboot in 7m for kernel security updates (maint-2026-08-12-3). Sessions on that host may drop. :warning:

Oncall: confirm  we are doing a rolling reboot across east hosts. If you landed on the rebooted host you'll see drops; try `ssh bastion.prod -J jump.redwood` to bounce to a different host during the window.

Ruth (new-hire): ok I added ServerAliveInterval and switched to ProxyJump. Also forced WG DNS to 10.0.4.2 in the client. Saw one drop exactly during the maintenance window but otherwise stable. Git HTTPS failures stopped after pinning DNS. Thanks! :relieved:

Katarina (it-support): added a tiny onboarding note: "If using a thunderbolt dock or switching interfaces, pin internal DNS and enable ssh keepalives; prefer ProxyJump." We'll also roll an updated WG profile for new hires that includes the resolver and covers gitlab subnets.

Ben (infra): if you want me to remote into your session and double-check routing while you're at your desk I can pair. Welcome aboard! :tada:
